en.description:
STAR Ace is a fast arcade space shooter for iPhone and Apple Watch. Join Cosmo, the bravest otter pilot in the galaxy, and fly his starfighter through a full story of sectors and bosses, then take on a second galaxy.

FEATURES
- Rail-shooter action made for touch: drag to fly, hold to charge and lock on up to 6 targets, release to fire homing missiles.
- Barrel rolls, boost, bombs and elemental weapons: water, lightning, fire, ice and wind.
- Huge bosses that lose parts as you fight them, each with its own attacks and music.
- Varied worlds: stormy seas, asteroid belts, a 3D magma tunnel, frozen nebulae, sky fortresses and the black-hole Devourer.
- 2D anime cutscenes and a full story with Cosmo and his squadron.
- Missions mode to replay any stage and beat your high score.
- Versus and Co-op for 2 to 4 pilots, online with Game Center or on the same Wi-Fi.
- Your progress syncs through iCloud between your devices.

PLAY ANYWHERE
On iPhone with smooth high-frame-rate 3D graphics, or right on your wrist with Apple Watch and the Digital Crown.

Free to download: try the first stages for free and unlock the full game with a single one-time purchase.
en.releaseNotes: Fixed the intro video of the Magma stage, which was showing the wrong boss video. Smoother stage cinematics.
en.subtitle: Arcade dogfight on your wrist

versionHistory.releaseNotes: New app icon and general improvements.
Performance and stability improvements, plus refined controls and menus for smoother dogfights on your wrist.

STAR Ace is now free to download! Stage 1 is free; unlock all 10 stages with a one-time purchase (or restore it). Previous buyers keep everything. New: wall gaps, diagonal barriers, slalom gates, sliding gates and a winding canyon - every world has its own obstacles.
Updated App Store screenshots and artwork. Bug fixes and polish.
The iPhone companion now links to more ARIAgames Apple Watch games. Small improvements.

STAR Ace is now a full space shooter for iPhone and Apple Watch!
- Play the first two sectors and the first boss for free, then unlock all 20 stages and every boss with a one-time purchase.
- New story order: fly each sector, then face its boss in the "II" sector.
- Magma Tunnel rebuilt as a wide 3D rock tunnel with bends, lava creatures and a huge lava cavern for the boss.
- New boss designs: Magmorax the lava turtle and Cryonyx the frozen battleship.
- Your wingmen now fly the same interceptor as Cosmo, each with their own colors.
- Clearer Versus menu: VS the CPU, Co-op or Battle, in three simple steps.
- The final boss now fires eye lasers.
- New 2D anime cutscenes, a new ending and new boss music.
- Progress syncs through iCloud between Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad.
- Pause button, clearer boss hits, sharper Apple Watch graphics and many fixes.

The final boss strikes back! The Omega Devourer is now much tougher, and the sky turns dark and terrifying. New exclusive weapon: NOVA SEEKERS, homing missiles with starburst explosions, available only against the Devourer. Plus a new cinematic before the final stage. The game is now listed in 9 languages.
A new, redesigned unlock screen with Cosmo and the four bosses, plus new App Store screenshots. Bug fixes and polish.
New App Store screenshots and polish.
A brand-new epic ending! Plus: the full game is now easier to find — unlock it right after beating the first boss or from the main menu — and free pilots get one Versus / Co-op match every day.

Beat the game to unlock ACE MODE: a tougher story run, marked with a gold star in the menu. The Omega Devourer has been redrawn with a terrifying new eye, and the ending cinematic has been remade. Fixed the ship lighting on the Apple Watch title screen.
Versus: new REMATCH button to fight again with the same pilots, and fixed online pilot names. Removed the lightning storm from the first stages for a cleaner, fairer flight.
Fixed the intro video of the Magma stage, which was showing the wrong boss video. Smoother stage cinematics.
